base_commit: 62ba1af plus preserved working tree, including new EditorDocument implementation
mode: Assessment only. No application/test/project/signing changes for this review.
positioning: Everyday image workspace and productivity utility; not Photoshop parity or photo management.

assessment.findings: Managed imports, thumbnails, filters, selection persistence, captured batch inputs, per-photo editing, contextual GIF selection and source retention exist. Editor actions can use explicit IDs. Layered compositions are mostly entered from File commands; the user must still understand which workflow/selection a command refers to. Scope controls and terminology vary across screens.

Resize/crop/orientation, conversion, compression, naming, watermark, adjustments, filters and metadata share ProcessingConfiguration. plannedRequests freezes jobs; export is serial, reports results/progress, supports cancellation/retry and collision-safe publication. Review throughput/latency and make override inheritance understandable. This is a fixed processing pipeline, not user-reorderable steps.

Crop/straighten/rotation/flips/resize; exposure, brightness, contrast, saturation, warmth, tint, highlights, shadows, vibrance and colour-family HSL. Filters/Auto Enhance, zoom/pan/detail view, compare and Undo exist. No general sharpen control found. Live input responsiveness and retouch quality are not fully accepted.

Persistent editable arrows, lines, rectangles, ellipses, text, speech bubbles, freehand and stickers; direct transform/property controls. No first-class highlight/callout tools or automatic numbering/reordering logic. Photo annotations use width-scaled text, while document text has real size/traits: two related authoring models need shared primitives without changing old rendering.

assessment.status: Partial; stronger export claim needs acceptance gate
assessment.findings: Opaque cover, blur, pixelate and frosted masks exist; masks flatten through the image renderer and suppress copied source metadata. Editable documents deliberately contain original resources. Blur/pixelation are not secure redaction. Opaque export coverage and metadata/container checks must be verified across formats and creations before using the stronger product claim.

Version-1 .ameluma packages, image/text/shape layers, reorder/duplicate/visibility/locks/opacity, eight blend modes, handles/numeric transforms, source ownership, recovery and document-local history exist. No drawing layer, group/merge UI, align/distribute/snap, editable per-layer photo-adjustment inspector or direct GIF/workspace handoff. Real interaction QA remains open.

assessment.status: Implemented separately; consolidate entry and presentation
assessment.findings: The collage catalog generates 74 layouts across aspect ratios, columns, feature layouts, brick/pinboard and strips. Collages have independent placements, captions/style, histories and saved tabs. These are not EditorDocument layers. Reuse/curate existing patterns for six everyday tasks instead of adding another layout engine or more mosaic work.

Both entry routes, captured per-frame settings/IDs, reorder/duplicate/remove/add, per-frame/multi timing, speed, loop count, canvas/fitting, preview, annotations, persistence and validated export exist. Photo watermarks can be captured inside frames; no equivalent dedicated animation-wide watermark design control. Presets mainly change dimensions, not palette/quantisation strategy.

assessment.status: Implemented curated base; custom saving/QA incomplete
assessment.findings: 24 original recipes in Essentials, Film, Cinema and Monochrome; versions, intensity, Original, Auto Enhance, previews/compare and explicit batch application. No dedicated named user filter-preset library. Existing output-profile saving is broader than saving a look. Do not confuse quantity or existing tests with visual approval across skin tones/materials.

Text OR image mark; font picker currently offers four text fonts; relative width, nine-position anchors, custom offsets, margin, opacity, rotation, tiling, direct handles and saved preset values. Shared final-stage renderer and batch/profile integration. Single-content model cannot author an editable text+logo design with multiple elements.
assessment.evidence: Models.swift: WatermarkConfiguration; Watermarking/WatermarkRenderer.swift; SharedUI/Inspectors.swift: watermarkControls; FramingViews.swift: watermark canvas

assessment.findings: No dedicated multi-element authoring, named/versioned app-wide design library, curated template set, monogram/social/studio design workflow, outline/shadow element styling or design preview backgrounds. Current watermarkPresets is an array of single watermark configurations, with text-derived labels or numbered image names. Existing layers are useful groundwork, not a finished designer.

assessment.status: Partial precursors; new user recipe flow missing
assessment.findings: ExportProfile can retain a configuration/naming/destination. AutomationRecipe supports enabled action groups and watched folders, but deliberately uses fixed order. Neither is a general named sequence with faithful reorder/enable/preview semantics. Current saveProfile retains traced recolouring and resolved Auto Enhance, so it is not a safe generic recipe capture mechanism.
assessment.evidence: Models.swift: ExportProfile; Apps/Shared/Workspace.swift: saveProfile; Automations/AutomationModels.swift; Apps/macOS/Automations.swift

assessment.findings: No Command-K registration or searchable action palette found. Existing scoped command methods and menu actions can be reused. A deterministic action search/parser is sufficient; an AI/NLU service is unnecessary.

assessment.status: Missing user workflow; native groundwork exists
assessment.findings: Foreground masks are already requested in recolouring, followed by colour restriction and polygon extraction. No persistent foreground-alpha edit, one-click cutout, edge refinement or background replacement workflow. The recolour polygon is not an adequate soft-alpha subject matte.

Native capability-checked JPEG/PNG/HEIC/TIFF and conditional WebP; quality/target-size, colour/metadata policy, flattened output, naming and collision safety. Encoded proof reports measured bytes using the export encoder. New Convert preserves dimensions unless resize is requested. New document export lacks export-time resizing, proof and profile parity with photo export.

Workspace schema 4 with legacy migration and sparse patches; lightweight local instructions, per-creation state and sessions; portable .ameluma version 1 owns resources. Photo/batch timeline is shared; document history is separate; creation histories differ. Saved content restores, session Undo does not. New designs/recipes must protect sources required by saved work, pending jobs and history.

Native SwiftUI/AppKit inputs, adaptive panels, explicit Cancel/Apply, context menus and shared viewport state exist. Photo uses a different toolbox/options arrangement from the new left-toolbar document editor. Core image previews are bounded, but source/UI pathways still need measured input-to-feedback and stroke-to-result testing. Whole-canvas composition materialisation is not a tiled paint engine.

The latest utility/workspace vision supersedes earlier Photoshop-alternative language. Help has accumulated multiple workflow sections and some legacy library terminology. Filtering now correctly documents retained hidden selections; do not reintroduce the old finding as if still present. Distinguish local workspace instructions, portable documents, presets, recipes and watched-folder automations.

checks.outcome: 21 tests, 0 failures; native app/test target builds
